outcome: At least one SWBA <= -1 onset during the next 1, 2, or 3 months; forecast origins must have SWBA > -1.

feature_sets.seasonal_baseline: Origin-calendar-month onset-window prevalence smoothed toward training prevalence with 12 prior months.

evaluation: Chronological 2006-2025 folds previously examined during development; this is a retrospective feasibility screen, not independent validation. Training outcome windows end before each test block. Test origins are restricted so their complete outcome windows end within each block.
limitations: No warning threshold or false-warning episode rate is evaluated.
Adjacent forecast windows overlap and are statistically dependent.
Historical predictor values are not proof of issue-time availability.
The final test fold excludes origins whose outcome window extends beyond 2025.
